contentHtml:
TREATMENT

GFC Therapy in Ghaziabad

Stronger Roots, Thicker Hair, Greater Confidence

Overview

GFC (Growth Factor Concentrate) Therapy is an advanced hair restoration treatment designed to support healthier hair growth and improve overall scalp health.

The procedure utilizes concentrated growth factors derived from the individual’s own blood, which are then carefully introduced into targeted areas of the scalp. These growth factors help stimulate hair follicles, improve blood circulation, and support the natural hair growth cycle. GFC Therapy is commonly considered for individuals experiencing hair thinning, early-stage hair loss, or reduced hair density.

As a minimally invasive procedure, it aims to promote stronger, thicker, and healthier-looking hair with little to no downtime. Treatment recommendations are typically tailored according to the individual's hair condition and goals.

Key benefits

  • Permanent, natural-looking results
  • Painless FUE — no stitches, no scars
  • PRP boosts existing hair density
  • Single-day procedure
  • Performed by trained surgical team

Who should opt

  • Men & women with stable pattern hair-loss
  • Receding hairlines or thinning crown
  • Patients seeking density without medication
